### Recent Releases

<!-- RECENT_RELEASES -->
<ul>
<li>
  <strong>2026-11-22</strong> – <a href="https://github.com/insin/control-panel-for-twitter">control-panel-for-twitter</a> <a href="https://github.com/insin/control-panel-for-twitter/releases/tag/v4.99.3">v4.99.3</a>
  <div><em>Browser extension which gives you more control over your Twitter timeline and adds missing features and UI improvements - for desktop and mobile</em></div>
  <details><summary>v4.99.3 release notes</summary><p>Visit the <a href="https://soitis.dev/control-panel-for-twitter" rel="nofollow">Control Panel for Twitter website</a> for installation links, more information about the extension, and FAQs (mostly about why Safari is so weird about extensions).</p>
<p>Follow <a href="https://twitter.com/ControlPanelFT" rel="nofollow">@ControlPanelFT</a> on Twitter or <a href="https://bsky.app/profile/soitis.dev" rel="nofollow">@soitis.dev</a> on Bluesky for updates.</p>
<h2>Changes</h2>
<ul>
<li>Added a "Hide paid partnership Tweets" option (default: enabled)</li>
<li>Added a "Legacy" options style which uses the pre-v4.99 options layout</li>
<li>"Hide Retweets in Lists" is now off by default</li>
<li>"Hide Money" now hides payment cards in Tweets</li>
<li>Fixed importing settings exports containing obsolete keys (from the preview build)</li>
<li>Reorganised the options page</li>
</ul>
<h3><a href="https://blog.x.com/en/engineering/rebuilding-the-global-town-square-from-scratch" rel="nofollow">New X UI</a> only</h3>
<div class="markdown-alert markdown-alert-note"><p class="markdown-alert-title"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-info mr-2" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M0 8a8 8 0 1 1 16 0A8 8 0 0 1 0 8Zm8-6.5a6.5 6.5 0 1 0 0 13 6.5 6.5 0 0 0 0-13ZM6.5 7.75A.75.75 0 0 1 7.25 7h1a.75.75 0 0 1 .75.75v2.75h.25a.75.75 0 0 1 0 1.5h-2a.75.75 0 0 1 0-1.5h.25v-2h-.25a.75.75 0 0 1-.75-.75ZM8 6a1 1 0 1 1 0-2 1 1 0 0 1 0 2Z"></path></svg>Note</p><p>If your account doesn't have the new X UI, open <a href="https://x.com/i/xweb" rel="nofollow">https://x.com/i/xweb</a> with Control Panel for Twitter enabled and we'll put you on it temporarily (it goes away if you refresh or close the tab)</p>
</div>
<ul>
<li>Added an option to show images in a grid instead of a carousel</li>
<li>Added support for the "Default sorting of replies" option</li>
<li>"Hide Premium upsells" now hides Analytics upsells in your own Tweets</li>
<li>Excluded your own Tweets from most options which hide specific types of Tweet</li>
<li>Fixed restoring Twitter theming to the Tweet Composer after an X UI change</li>
<li>Fixed layout of restored interaction links after an X UI change</li>
</ul>
<h3>Current X UI only</h3>
<ul>
<li>Added support for the "Hide AI Tweets" option</li>
</ul>
<h2><a id="user-content-availability"></a>Availability (3/5)</h2>
<p>New versions have to be reviewed and approved for each browser before they're available to install or upgrade to.</p>
<p>This version is available for the following browsers:</p>
<p><a href="https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/control-panel-for-twitter/" title="Firefox and Firefox for Android" rel="nofollow"><img src="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/226692/212897487-f3993495-2032-44a4-b0c6-1bd1d9cc56dd.png" alt="Firefox and Firefox for Android" style="max-width: 100%;"></a> <a href="https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/control-panel-for-twitter/kpmjjdhbcfebfjgdnpjagcndoelnidfj" title="Google Chrome and Chromium-based browsers" rel="nofollow"><img src="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/226692/212897023-9e66b1b0-e1cd-44df-a4f2-3d5bda80c5f8.png" alt="Google Chrome and Chromium-based browsers" style="max-width: 100%;"></a> <a href="https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/control-panel-for-twitter/foccddlibbeccjiobcnakipdpkjiijjp" title="Edge and Edge for Android" rel="nofollow"><img src="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/226692/212897573-34b1af0a-dc5a-4aa2-a1e7-ca85d3823f9f.png" alt="Edge and Edge on Android" style="max-width: 100%;"></a></p>
